title: A pieces of thin junk. Don’t waste your money on this.
text:
A pieces of thin junk. Don’t waste your money on this.. A few years ago I bought 45 pieces of Calphalon Commercial Usa cookware for my self and my two kids.
Thank goodness it was guarantee for life. Believe me it is not for life, but far better then
this pieces of Calphalon junk made in China.
I never put any of my cookware in the dishwasher. I hand wash it.

This roaster is thin, light weight, will warp on the stove top, and not easy to clean. I have a gas stove.

Do yourself a favor, do not waste your money on this calphalon junk.

( I bought a large Tramontina roaster from Amazon last year. Heavier, great for stove top for gravy also., love it.)
I have nothing to do with Tramontina, but Calphalon is not like it use to be, and nether is there service.

product_metadata.title: Calphalon Classic Hard-Anodized 16-Inch Roasting Pan with Nonstick Rack
features: Roasting pan made of medium-gauge hard-anodized aluminum for even heating
Nonstick rack elevates foods for even browning, and allows fats and liquids to drain away
Highly polished stainless steel handles for safe, secure transport
Oven safe up to 450 degrees F
description: The Calphalon Classic 16-Inch Hard-Anodized Roaster with Nonstick Rack easily holds a holiday turkey or ham, a chicken, or a roast with vegetables. The roasting pan features two double-riveted stainless steel handles for a secure grip when lifting from the oven. The nonstick rack has side handles and is coated so that foods will not stick.
